meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清理代码中AI生成的坏味道与冗余痕迹
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常担心AI助手留下的代码不够干净
copy.tagline_en: Clean up AI-generated code smells and redundant patterns in your recent changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often worry about messy code left by AI assistants

howto.what: 它会清掉代码改动里“AI 味”的坏味道:动手前先写回归测试把现有行为锁住,再分类删掉多余注释、死代码、过度防御等,之后用测试与静态检查验收,不过就回滚。默认只处理当前分支相对 main 的改动,也可给文件清单。
howto.when: 当你说要“清理最近改动”“给改动去 AI 味”或“去掉 AI 生成的坏味道”时触发;也可以把具体文件清单交给它作为处理范围。

say.text: 帮我清理当前分支改动里的 AI 代码味。
say.note: 会先为这些改动补回归测试,通过后才开始删。

say.text: 把最近这批改动的 AI 坏味道去掉。
say.note: 会按注释、死代码等分类清理,再跑测试验证。

say.text: 请清理这几个文件的 AI 味。
say.note: 把文件路径附在后面,就只清理这些文件。

howto.what_en: Locks behavior with regression tests, then removes redundant comments, dead code, over-defensive checks, etc.; validates with tests/lint; reverts on failure. Scope: branch diff or explicit file list.
howto.when_en: Activates when the user asks to clean up, 'deslop', or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes; also when an explicit file list is passed.

say_en.text: Please clean up the AI code smell in my current branch changes.
say_en.note: It will write regression tests to lock behavior before cleanup.

say_en.text: Remove AI-generated slop from these recent changes.

say_en.note: You can list file paths to narrow the scope.
